Bayesian Inference

Dirichlet-Multinomial posterior inference for transition networks. certainty() is the closed-form counterpart of bootstrap_network(); bayes_compare() is the complement of permutation().

certainty() print(<net_certainty>)
Estimate the Bayesian certainty of transition network edges
bayes_compare() print(<net_bayes>) summary(<net_bayes>) plot(<net_bayes>) print(<net_bayes_group>) plot(<net_bayes_group>) summary(<net_bayes_group>)
Compare two transition networks with a Bayesian Dirichlet model
subtract_networks() print(<netdifference>)
Subtract one network from another
as_netdifference()
Convert a network comparison to a difference network
